title: Preflight CNY001 registry handoff before browser gate
mission: Verify the repository-local CNY001 handoff contract from durable plate/context/publication evidence into the canonical PAGE_WATCH_REGISTRY and gh-pages Live pages projection without registering the canary before its representative public JavaScript-browser gate. Add a bounded static guard if the handoff is not already protected. Do not mutate Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.

Verify CNY001 plate, context and publication receipt agree on page_id, public URL, published revision and CANARY_ONLY_NO_CURRENT_NO_HUMAN_ACCEPTED authority.
Verify CNY001 is absent from the canonical registry/Live projection while representative public JavaScript-browser reachability remains unverified.
Record next_change_number and the deterministic would-be registry entry/preconditions for a later steward, but do not consume P### or mutate the registry before the browser gate passes.
Add or identify a repository regression that prevents premature CNY001 registration; persist exact tests/evidence.
Return representative_javascript_browser/browser_network_navigation_to_github_pages as the external gate and name the exact downstream registry consumer.
No Current, Human Accepted or Served promotion.
